name: Takizawa Kensuke
source:
The protagonist is a college student. He’s into public exposure and outdoor sex, but his girlfriend wasn’t into that at all.

She’d long been uncomfortable with things like him opening the window while they had sex at home and when he recently suggested having sex outdoors, she finally broke up with him.

He’s on the tall side, slim but reasonably muscular, and a good-looking guy who’s pretty popular with women when he keeps to himself.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/227185/]Getchu[/url]]
